content: We need to return mapped_rxn and template_id for the template that reproduces the HWE reaction retrosynthetically. The previous step (make_5_lvl2-apply_template-1) gave precursors list from applying some template. Those precursors are three SMILES strings. Likely the template used there is the one we need. We need to retrieve its mapped_rxn and template_id (the integer ID). We have precursors but not template ID. We need to find which template produced those precursors. Could search templates that when applied to target produce those precursors. Use search_template_catalog_by_criteria with functional groups broken/formed appropriate for HWE: broken: C-P (phosphonate) and C-O (maybe O-P? but functional groups list includes 'trimethylsilyl' etc). Actually broken groups: carbon-phosphorus bond broken, carbon-oxygen bond broken (the C-O of the phosphonate? maybe O-P). But functional groups list does not include C-P. So we cannot filter by that. Instead we can search for templates that form aliphatic carboxylic acid and C-C double bond. Those are in list. So functional_groups_formed: ['aliphatic carboxylic acid', 'C-C double bonds']. Broken maybe 'phosphonate' not in list. Could just search with formed criteria.
